calibration_guidance: Use the full numeric range. High scientific upside is welcome only when the transfer is concrete, adapted, compatible, and calculable. It must also advance a consequential target-domain problem; mathematical sophistication, formal elegance, or interdisciplinary framing alone does not justify a high total. Apply a removal counterfactual and prefer the minimal direct transfer: remove each assumption, method, observable, compatibility check, or validation layer that can be deferred without making the same transfer undefined, infeasible, non-novel, or scientifically inconsequential. Treat translation or setup errors that can be repaired without replacing the transfer nucleus as actionable feedback, not as a reason to erase the direction from scientific comparison. Apply a functional counterfactual to the claimed connection as well: removing it should remove or materially weaken a solution, constraint, prediction, capability, or executable route; a change only in terminology, representation, or perceived elegance has no substantive value. A plausible analogy, an elegant reframing without substantive problem progress, or an incremental target application should not receive a high total.

marks.label: Intent Relevance
marks.guidance: Score alignment with the user's requested scientific outcome, target, and constraints.

marks.label: Transfer
marks.guidance: 15 requires a specific valid source ingredient, a nontrivial target adaptation, and a new target capability that concretely solves or advances a target-domain problem; loose analogies or decorative imports score near zero. Counterfactually removing the source connection must remove or materially weaken that capability or route. Mathematical sophistication or formal elegance without that problem progress also scores near zero.

marks.label: Target Contribution
marks.guidance: Score the importance and specificity of the new target-domain result as concrete progress on the target-domain problem, not the sophistication or elegance of its interdisciplinary reframing. The source domain need not receive a contribution. Substantial work begins at 14.

marks.label: Novelty
marks.guidance: Score publishable novelty of the minimal source-to-target core result if successful; do not add novelty marks by bundling known ingredients, optional observables, or avoidable restrictions.

marks.label: Confidence
marks.guidance: Score evidence that the proposal is unclaimed after focused source-domain, target-domain, and intersection searches.

marks.label: Value
marks.guidance: Score scientific upside of the minimal core result and whether target-domain experts should care, not the sum of optional outputs or extensions.

marks.label: Feasibility
marks.guidance: Score whether the bounded first calculation is the shortest minimally sufficient route that is physically compatible, executable, proportionately validated, and paired with a useful kill criterion; do not reward removable machinery.

marks.label: Well-definedness
marks.guidance: Score whether the shortest minimally sufficient domains, translation map, setup, assumptions, observable, and deliverable are sharp enough to begin work without rewarding extra model choices or formal layers.

total_score.label: Total
total_score.guidance: Set total_score to the closest integer after summing all marks. Preserve actionable feedback for repairable translation and setup errors while comparing every reviewed transfer on this common scale.
